title: bug(core): 400 Bad Request: "Function call is missing a thought_signature in functionCall parts" during parallel tool calls

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a clear, actionable bug report detailing a 400 Bad Request / INVALID_ARGUMENT error during parallel tool calls and history hardening with Gemini 3+ / Vertex AI models due to missing thought_signature on functionCall parts.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The bug root cause is localized to clear logic checks in geminiChat.ts and historyHardening.ts where loops break early or only process the first function call in a turn instead of all parallel function calls.

summary.problem: Executing parallel tool calls or history hardening causes 400 Bad Request / INVALID_ARGUMENT errors when using Gemini 3+ or Vertex AI models because functionCall parts beyond the first in a turn are missing thoughtSignature.
summary.root_cause: In packages/core/src/core/geminiChat.ts, the loop enforcing thought signatures on functionCall parts breaks after processing the first functionCall in a message turn. Similarly, in packages/core/src/utils/historyHardening.ts, pairToolsAndEnforceSignatures only attaches SYNTHETIC_THOUGHT_SIGNATURE to the first function call in a model turn rather than all functionCall parts.
summary.context: Gemini 3+ and Vertex AI models strictly enforce that all functionCall parts in a model turn include a thought_signature property.

steps: In packages/core/src/core/geminiChat.ts, update the loop in active loop thought signature enforcement to iterate through all parts without breaking early after the first functionCall part, ensuring every functionCall part lacking a thoughtSignature receives SYNTHETIC_THOUGHT_SIGNATURE.

In packages/core/src/utils/historyHardening.ts, update pairToolsAndEnforceSignatures so that all functionCall parts in a model turn lacking a thoughtSignature are updated with SYNTHETIC_THOUGHT_SIGNATURE rather than only the first one.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: All functionCall parts in a model turn (including parallel tool calls) will have thoughtSignature attached when sent in request contents or hardened history, preventing 400 Bad Request API errors.
verification_steps: Run existing unit tests using Vitest to ensure no regressions.

Add unit tests in packages/core/src/core/geminiChat.test.ts and packages/core/src/utils/historyHardening.test.ts verifying that multiple parallel functionCall parts in a single model turn all receive thoughtSignature when missing.
